title: Q-SPEC-15-g2-requirement-map: Gate G2 maps every requirement of A-PLN-1 to an item and a probe
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "requirement_map" -- workers/core/kernel/lifecycle.js
**Status:** open

US-SPEC-15 gate G2 says every requirement maps to at least one item and one probe. `checkGate` in workers/core/kernel/lifecycle.js checks only that the project has work items and that each has a closing probe; it never reads the requirements of the scope statement. Give A-PLN-1 a form in workers/core/lifecycle-gates/index.js (`FORMS`): `requirements`, each with an id, a testable statement and the item ids that deliver it. At G2, fail with one reason per requirement that names no existing item or whose items have no closing probe, so `fileGateGaps` files it for the product manager. Tests in workers/core/kernel/lifecycle.test.js and workers/core/lifecycle-gates/lifecycle-gates.test.js.

size: M
**Out of scope:** judging whether a requirement is well written, new tables, the read-back of US-SPEC-16.

Prediction: spec_quality >= 0.9 within 336 h

**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q "requirement_map" -- workers/core/kernel/lifecycle.test.js and the status row of US-SPEC-15 for the G2 mapping reads BUILT with the file and its test.
